source: TSTD, comprehensive mung bean cultivation manual, "សណ្តែកបាយ" [Mung bean], 2013
text: Disease coverage includes Cercospora leaf spot (circular necrotic leaf lesions), mungbean yellow mosaic virus (whitefly-transmitted, causing yellow mosaic leaf patterning and stunting), and root/basal stem rot together with charcoal rot (soil-borne fungal diseases attacking the root/crown area, worse under waterlogged or drought-stressed conditions respectively) — each profiled with symptoms and general cultural/chemical control guidance (resistant variety choice where available, field drainage, crop rotation, seed treatment, and fungicide use for established infections).
